name: 飛水峡
finding: Prefecture locates the visitor gorge beginning east of Kami-Asou station; do not treat every station along the 12 km river as an interchangeable entrance.

name: 琴引浜
finding: Tourism authority explicitly directs visitors via Amino station and Tankai Kotohikihama bus stop.

name: 仏眼院
finding: City history museum's visitor leaflet explicitly identifies three rail gateways and Fureai bus Inaba route Maedo-fudo-mae.

name: 栃原岩陰遺跡
finding: Nagano official tourism names Koumi station with village bus approach. Bus stop identity needs village/operator evidence; generic nearby train stops are not additional gateways.

name: 金生遺跡
finding: Prefectural tourism guide updated 2025-12-10 names Nagasaka/Kai-Oizumi and Jonan bus stop.

name: 釈迦堂遺跡群
finding: Official museum for the excavated site identifies station, local bus stop and expressway bus stop. PA is not a rail/bus node without exact boarding-point evidence. Museum/site endpoint distinction remains flagged.

name: 上之宮遺跡
finding: City visitor walking circuit begins/ends Sakurai station and expressly includes this ruin; the buried remains are represented by the public restored garden.

name: 韮崎中央公園陸上競技場
finding: City tourism page includes the athletic ground and directs public transport through Nirasaki station / Nirasaki Chuo Taiikukan bus stop.

name: 日本基督教団神戸教会
finding: Kobe International Community Center's church directory binds exact 9-16 Hanakuma address to these stations; operator's adjacent church kindergarten corroborates JR/Hanshin Motomachi, municipal Kenchomae and Hankyu/Han akuma approach. Other Kobe churches rejected.

name: 四高記念文化交流館
finding: Official venue and tourism name Kanazawa and Korinbo approaches, but repair closure must be separately adjudicated; do not imply interior currently open.
